dedupe_keys.name: consolidated national file of electric vehicle charging points irve as re published on local open data portals

description: Consolidated national file of electric vehicle charging points (IRVE), as re-published on local open data portals is a dataset listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by 19 French local portals re-publishing a national dataset. 21 datasets on 19 portals hold the consolidated French file of publicly accessible electric vehicle charging points (location, operator, power, connector types and access conditions), as re-published or filtered to a local area by the portals listed here. Coverage: France; each copy is limited to the area of its portal (for example Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis, Boulogne-Billancourt, Brittany, Centre-Val de Loire). The copies sit on: boulognebillancourt-seineouest.opendatasoft.com, ccphva.opendatasoft.com, chaville-seineouest.opendatasoft.com, data.ampmetropole.fr, data.bretagne.bzh, data.centrevaldeloire.fr, data.grandparissud.fr, data.issy.com and others. Each copy has its own page, description and export. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/), Licence Ouverte 2.0 (E. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
